main.description: A space's newest memories and links between the ones that mean similar things, for drawing the space as a graph. Only memories indexed with the space's model are included. Each memory links to its nearest neighbors among the memories returned. Same authentication as garden.engram.searchMemories.

limit.description: How many of the newest memories to include.

neighbors.description: How many of its most similar memories each memory links to.

minSimilarity.description: A number above 0 and at most 1 (default 0.4): the cosine similarity a pair needs to be linked.

a.description: Position of one memory in nodes. Always smaller than b.

b.description: Position of the other memory in nodes.

errors.name: UnknownSpace
errors.description: This service does not index the space.

errors.name: NoModel
errors.description: The space has not declared an embedding model.
